_comment: Hand-editable: opts games into global leaderboards. Value is the board kind — 'time' = ms survived, auto-captured from session length (great for endless/survival games); 'score' = raw points, captured via a postMessage({type:'jeo-score',score}) from the game. scan.js merges this into games_list.json; this file wins over any <!--LEADERBOARD--> marker in a game's HTML.
